Every construct the YAML reader takes, in one pipeline-shaped document: a flow sequence and a flow mapping on one line, plain and quoted scalars, a key with spaces, a single-quoted key with a doubled quote, an escaped double-quoted string, empty collections, a null written as nothing and as a tilde, a URL with a hash that is no comment, literal and folded block scalars with each ending mark, a sequence at its key's own indentation, a sequence nested on a dash, a mapping under a bare dash, and a key YAML 1.1 read as a boolean.
